examples.title: Black out pixels outside the bounding box
examples.code:
# Remove replicated edge pixels outside the current bounding box.
black_outside = nuke.createNode("BlackOutside")
black_outside.setInput(0, source)

provenance.editorial_note: Assumes source is an existing image node.
